cadence_cancel_analysis.description: Inspect cancellation capability for an admitted operation. Native active cancellation is unsupported; terminal jobs are no-ops. No process is signalled and cancellation is never claimed.

cadence_cancel_design_sweep.description: Cancel only recorded children of an admitted design ID/sweep UUID. Uncertain sends/cancellation stay UNKNOWN; no unrelated process is signaled.

cadence_check_variable_values.description: Check explicit decimal text and units locally. Never execute, mutate or fill defaults; numeric admissibility grants no electrical or execution qualification.
cadence_check_variable_values.name: cadence_check_variable_values

cadence_compare_corner_results.description: Compare exact NN, FF, and SS metric values against the NN reference.
cadence_compare_corner_results.name: cadence_compare_corner_results

cadence_describe_analog_measurement.description: Describe one registered analog metric and exact method, unit, source and qualification requirements. No caller formula, frequency, path or registration.
cadence_describe_analog_measurement.name: cadence_describe_analog_measurement

cadence_describe_design.description: Describe the logical allowlists of one registered design ID without source bindings. Environment, PDK, variable ranges and generic execution remain unqualified.
cadence_describe_design.name: cadence_describe_design

cadence_describe_design_sweep.description: Describe a registered design/analysis/variable and same-analysis measurement IDs for local 1D sweep planning. Returns contract hash, fixed-value requirements and blockers; no execution, defaults, range qualification or transport.
cadence_describe_design_sweep.name: cadence_describe_design_sweep

cadence_describe_measurement.description: Describe a registered design/measurement ID and its contract hash, fixed units/method and read eligibility. No private bindings, registration or execution.
cadence_describe_measurement.name: cadence_describe_measurement

cadence_describe_pdk_adapter.description: Inspect a registered PDK ID without physical bindings or model data.
cadence_describe_pdk_adapter.name: cadence_describe_pdk_adapter

cadence_describe_specification.description: Describe an operator-registered target, exact unit, measurement-definition hash and conditions; obtain its contract hash before evaluation. No caller target.
cadence_describe_specification.name: cadence_describe_specification

cadence_describe_storage_artifact.description: Describe one opaque registered artifact at the exact snapshot, including dependencies, classification and deletion reason. No filesystem path/content inputs.
cadence_describe_storage_artifact.name: cadence_describe_storage_artifact

cadence_design_pdk_status.description: Resolve a registered design's PDK and environment compatibility locally. Fixed native compatibility is not generic qualification or execution authority.
cadence_design_pdk_status.name: cadence_design_pdk_status

cadence_design_sweep_result.description: Read bounded admitted sweep points, exact effective inputs and completion measurement. NOT_RUN/UNKNOWN never imply success; spec_evaluation stays not_evaluated.
cadence_design_sweep_result.name: cadence_design_sweep_result

cadence_design_sweep_status.description: Read locally journaled status of an admitted design ID/sweep UUID; no replay.
cadence_design_sweep_status.name: cadence_design_sweep_status

cadence_design_write_plan.description: Read the one fixed copy-based property mutation plan and current target readiness; this performs no OA database write.
cadence_design_write_plan.name: cadence_design_write_plan

cadence_evaluate_specification.description: Evaluate one registered specification using its described contract hash and an optional admitted completed UUID4. Missing target: NOT_EVALUATED; missing selected operation: MISSING_MEASUREMENT; partial/unqualified measurement: UNQUALIFIED; differing conditions: CONDITION_MISMATCH. PASS/FAIL applies only to this exact operation. Invalid/failed source requests are errors, not FAIL. No caller facts, simulation or search.
cadence_evaluate_specification.name: cadence_evaluate_specification

cadence_execute_design_write_validation.description: Execute the approved one-time copy, dry-run, backup, fixed property apply, exact verification, and rollback sequence. Requires the exact reviewed confirmation and is destructive/state-changing.
cadence_execute_design_write_validation.name: cadence_execute_design_write_validation

cadence_execute_storage_cleanup.description: Dry-run by default. Execute only exact selected IDs from a hash-bound plan when an independent operator approval records explicit user selection for this UUID. Rechecks fingerprints/dependencies under EDA lock; protected/history/replay data cannot be deleted. Retry the same operation UUID; UNKNOWN never authorizes a blind retry. Only reviewed isolated intermediate leaves qualify; reservations never refund.
cadence_execute_storage_cleanup.name: cadence_execute_storage_cleanup

cadence_list_libraries.description: List only reviewed project libraries and allowed-cell counts; exclude paths and proprietary file content.

cadence_list_measurements.description: List registered bounded measurement definitions locally for a design ID. Reading requires an admitted completed analysis; no simulation or specification grant.

cadence_list_native_diagnostics.description: List fixed native ADE DC/AC/trap TRAN settings and provenance contract.

cadence_list_pdk_adapters.description: List registered logical PDK capabilities locally; no execution grant.

cadence_list_profiles.description: List reviewed simulation profiles and their fixed analyses, corners, and outputs.

cadence_list_specifications.description: List up to 32 operator-owned specifications for one registered design. Registry v7 is required; empty targets stay not_evaluated. No simulation or registration.

cadence_list_storage_artifacts.description: Page at most 20 opaque artifacts from an inspected snapshot. Snapshot drift fails closed. Age and extracted measurements do not grant deletion permission.

cadence_measure_dc_power.description: Calculate mean DC supply power under one explicit measurement contract.

cadence_plan_design_sweep.description: Plan at most 16 registered 1D points using the described contract hash, decimal strings/units and every non-axis fixed value. Use explicit values or exact linear start/stop/step. Reports numeric denials; all points NOT_RUN, no simulation, reservation or durable admission. Parameterized execution is unqualified.
cadence_plan_design_sweep.name: cadence_plan_design_sweep

cadence_plan_storage_cleanup.description: Plan at most 16 exact inspected artifact IDs. Returns stable hash, qualified candidates and protected exclusions without deleting. Report the plan for user selection.
cadence_plan_storage_cleanup.name: cadence_plan_storage_cleanup

cadence_plan_sweep.description: Validate and hash one bounded variable sweep of a reviewed profile.
cadence_plan_sweep.name: cadence_plan_sweep

cadence_prepare_design_sweep.description: Bind a registered 1D request to the existing sweep engine. Use described contract hash, exact decimal values/units and all fixed values. Only the registry-v5 compiled RC fixture has a parameterized route; real-design ranges remain unqualified. Returns execution plan hash and blockers without reserving or executing.
cadence_prepare_design_sweep.name: cadence_prepare_design_sweep

cadence_storage_summary.description: Inspect only registered reference result roots. Returns bounded totals, coverage, protected/replay/evidence classes, disk floor and cumulative reservations. No raw contents/paths or automatic deletion; partial totals are lower bounds.
cadence_storage_summary.name: cadence_storage_summary

cadence_submit_actual_diagnostic.description: Submit a fixed candidate DC or AC diagnostic under cumulative limits.
cadence_submit_actual_diagnostic.name: cadence_submit_actual_diagnostic

cadence_submit_analysis.description: Admit one UUID4 under its exact current plan hash and dispatch the compiled adapter. Retry the same ID: lookup only; never blindly resend. Native guards and cumulative budgets remain required.
cadence_submit_analysis.name: cadence_submit_analysis

cadence_submit_design_sweep.description: Submit/resume a prepared registered RC fixture sweep with the exact plan hash and stable experiment UUID. Reuse that UUID on retry/restart; changed contracts are denied. Uses existing shared EDA lock, cumulative Spectre/result budget and disk guards. No real-design bias sweep or analog specification claim.
cadence_submit_design_sweep.name: cadence_submit_design_sweep

cadence_submit_native_diagnostic.description: Submit native ADE netlist, Spectre and PSF extraction. Reuse operation_id on retry; existing IDs never execute again. Fixed candidate only; cumulative limits apply.
cadence_submit_native_diagnostic.name: cadence_submit_native_diagnostic

cadence_submit_profile.description: Submit one reviewed simulation profile with its exact variable contract; no raw netlist, OCEAN, SKILL, path, analysis, or output input is accepted.
